metadata.title: Guideline 1 Application — ADR Authoring (Milestone 1, Duo Excluded)
metadata.author: Denis
metadata.purpose: Execute the three-phase 'Decision → Validated ADR' workflow defined in guidelines/ARCHITECTURE_PROMPT_v1.md to produce specifications/ADR.md for Milestone 1 of the Blokus Configurable Game Engine. Per user instruction, Milestone 2 (Blokus Duo) was explicitly excluded from the decision basis; FR-1.2 (configurable game parameters) is retained only because it is an M1 SRS requirement in its own right.

conversation.content: Create specifications/ADR.md according to the instructions in ARCHITECTURE_PROMPT_v1.md. Ignore Milestone 2 for creating Blokus Duo completely for now.

conversation.summary: Read ARCHITECTURE_PROMPT_v1.md to extract the 12-step three-phase workflow; surveyed the project layout (deliverables/, guidelines/, prompts/, specifications/); read SPEC_M1.md in full to lock the binding FR/NFR/SC/IR IDs. Then authored specifications/ADR.md as a single self-contained document covering all phases without delegating to subagents.

scope_adjustment.interpretation: Removed Duo-readiness as a first-class architectural driver. Retained FR-1.2 generic configurability because it is in the M1 SRS itself, independent of Duo. Added a Drift Risk (DR-6) that forbids Duo-named code paths in M1 to keep the boundary explicit.
consequences_for_ADR: AMB-07 still cited as a reuse driver, but no longer framed as 'configuration-driven for Duo'.
Extensibility criterion in Phase 1 reweighted: cost-of-adding generic FR-1.2 parameters replaces cost-of-adding Duo.
Quality-attribute scenario for configurability uses a starting-position swap, not a Duo board change.

decisions_made_in_authoring: Selected Hexagonal (Ports-and-Adapters) over Layered and Plugin/Rule-Module. Phase-1 score: 36 vs 31 vs 26.
Selected DS-hexagonal-2 (Strategy + Command + Builder + Memento) as the winning architecture×design combination (41/45 on the 9-row rating table).
Kept the port set small (6 ports) and flagged port count as a 'Questionable' item for the human architect.
Documented DS-hexagonal-1 as an explicit fallback if Builder/Memento are judged premature for M1.
Used FR-3.4 lexicographic tie-break to drive a determinism tripwire (DR-3) rather than relying on a verbal claim.
Required the Memento to include ConfigVO as a field so the JSON round-trip is the single source of truth on dimensions (Senior Architect remediation #3 → DR-4).

sections: Phase 1 — Decision Frame; three candidate options (Layered, Hexagonal, Plugin); 8-criterion comparison table; ADR-001 / ADR-002 / ADR-003; ADR-FINAL-P1.

Phase 2 — Restated inputs; 9 design solutions as strict JSON (3 per architecture); per-design 4-axis human-review checklist; 9-row architecture×design rating table; ADR-FINAL-P2; Senior Architect Review with 5 flaws + remediations.

Phase 3 — Decision Basis Audit; one quality-attribute scenario per attribute (testability, configurability, performance, portability, maintainability, reproducibility) contrasted with rejected alternatives; 7-row Drift Risk register with concrete tripwires; Final Review Brief split Valid / Questionable / Follow-up.

conversation.summary: Wrote this JSON file (prompts/denis_ard_implementation.json) capturing the conversation, the scope adjustment (Duo excluded), the rationale behind the architectural and design choices encoded in specifications/ADR.md, and pointers to all referenced inputs and produced artifacts. Format follows the precedent set by prompts/denis_adr_prompt.json.

downstream_usage.intended_consumer: The human architects (Richard / Denis) reviewing specifications/ADR.md before locking the implementation kickoff.
expected_followups: Confirm port count (current ADR proposes 6; consider merging MoveValidator + LegalMoveEnumerator into GameSession).
Decide whether to downgrade DS-hexagonal-2 to DS-hexagonal-1 (drop Builder/Memento) if the team is new to those patterns.
Add an NFR-1.2 benchmark to the evaluation harness before deferring eager-vs-lazy legal-move enumeration.
Define the Memento JSON schema in a separate document so SC-1 round-trip becomes contract-tested.
Re-open this ADR (or supersede with a new one) before any future Blokus Duo or alternative-variant work is begun.
downstream_usage.human_in_the_loop: The LLM is an analytical assistant; the human architect makes the final call.
